children: Hyperliquid Policy Center Chief Executive Jake Chervinsky said policymakers did not focus on meme coin regulation in the last cycle because many viewed them as a short-lived trend, and trading volumes later fell sharply. According to Odaily, he said meme coins could become an important regulatory issue in crypto policy if they grow again on a large scale and enter the mainstream market.

title: Hyperliquid Policy Center CEO Says Meme Coin Regulation Could Become a Major Crypto Policy Issue
